commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+2' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Here comes a substitution. Mario Sauer (Toulouse) is brought on as a substitute for Yann Gboho.
87' A quickly taken corner by Lorient.
86' What was Rafik Messali (Toulouse) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
84' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lorient comes to nothing.

83' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it under the roof. Unfortunately for him, Guillaume Restes makes a great save to stop his effort.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rafik Messali (Toulouse) replaces Mark McKenzie.
80' Emersonn will be replaced by Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse).
80' Olivier Pantaloni has decided to substitute Dermane Karim and he is replaced by Mohamed Bamba (Lorient).
80' Substitution. Theo Le Bris (Lorient) in, Joel Mvuka Mugisha out.
79' Alexis Vossah (Toulouse) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
77' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
75' The cross into the penalty area from Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
73' Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
69' Substitution. Aiyegun Tosin is replaced by Sambou Soumano (Lorient).
69' That will be all from Pablo Pagis who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient).
66' Carles Martinez decides to make a substitution. Abu Francis will be replaced by Alexis Vossah (Toulouse).
65' 1 - 1 Goal! Yvon Mvogo gets a hand on the penalty from Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
65' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
63' Arthur Avom (Lorient) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem saw the whole situation. It's a penalty to Toulouse! Let's see who's going to take it.
62' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) produces a poor cross from the free kick which is easily turned away.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Laurent Abergel trots off the pitch and is replaced by Noah Cadiou (Lorient).
59' Golden opportunity! Dermane Karim (Lorient) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
58' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
53' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
51' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) picks up a wayward pass but gives away possession by shooting from distance. The ball went miles wide of the right post.
51' Lorient take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
50' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
49' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) makes a rough challenge and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Pablo Pagis (Lorient) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Guillaume Restes no chance!
44' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
42' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) makes a strong challenge and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows for a foul. PENALTY! One of the players from Lorient is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
41' A pass by Yann Gboho (Toulouse) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
39' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) has tested the patience of referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
37' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
33' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Pablo Pagis (Lorient), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
32' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) is booked.
32' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) and blew his whistle. Lorient are awarded a free kick.
31' A pass from Frank Magri (Toulouse) is intercepted by Yvon Mvogo and the move breaks down.
28' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
26' The resulting corner from Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
24' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
21' Lorient work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
20' Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

16' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
14' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
12' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yvon Mvogo intercepts the ball.
11' Emersonn (Toulouse) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
10' Toulouse are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
6' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
3' The corner from Yann Gboho (Toulouse) is hurriedly cleared.
3' The corner is swung in but Toulouse can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball is out of play. Toulouse will have a chance to score from a corner.
